Bosnia and Herzegovina, a country marred by ethnic tensions, has struggled to recover since its brutal 1992-95 war.

items.title: Biljana Plavsic, Bosnian Serb War Criminal Who Withdrew Her Remorse
items.summary: Plavsic, who died this week, was the only high-ranking woman political leader prosecuted for mass atrocities by the Yugoslav war crimes tribunal. She expressed sorrow for these acts in court – but then changed her mind.

items.title: Bosnia Mourns Wartime Co-Inventor of Limb-Saving Medical Device
